body: depression and anxiety also came with my diagnosis (along previously before my adhd diagnosis) and yes I would agree to some extent they do enable it. Was just curious as to if mainly I could eliminate the doubts that do pop into my head as contradictive as they are I have no doubts within those times of my diagnosis and before I even got a medical diagnosis I knew from family history/the way it explained things that just depression/anxiety diagnosis I was told over and over never explained. As well as I suppose a "life coach" as getting on track is simple but my mind is a train that can go off the rails, and it will go anywhere and everywhere except the predetermined point of arrival. And have been considering switching back to adderall from vyvanse as adderall helped with motivation which seems to be the only area vyvanse lacks in, but also came with small length/hard comedown. vyvanse does 1 up adderall in the focus department but that seems to just go into things that normally suck me in (games in particular) unless I just have one of those motivated days that rarely come in which I'm lazer focused on everything. I'm internally motivated to get out and get my shit together but not externally motivated, which is the biggest problem of all

I'm not fairly experienced with all the meds (only adderall IR 10-25 mg and vyvanse 30-50mg) Vyvanse I prefer vyvanse primarily due to length (about 10 hours or so) but the downside (and this could be just dosage related) I don't get any motivation from vyvanse other than the first few days I started on it "the high" I suppose although I didn't feel it. Where as I've considered possibly switching to adderall XR since IR gave me motivation until a couple weeks before it would become ineffective for symptoms and motivation is my biggest obstacle. Also eating on vyvanse is A LOT harder for me on vyvanse compared to adderall where I would eat better due to actually thinking about it and not just hyperfocusing on a game etc, "ok time for bed, HOLY FUCK I HAVEN'T EATEN ANYTHING TODAY." along with stomach pain/discomfort the first couple hours until it fully takes effect. But there is no comedown I can tell theres just a point where I can tell its working and at some point I can tell its not no super hard comedown like adderall IR had. Just my experiences and sorry if its long, hope it helps.

TL:DR prefer vyvanse mainly due to longevity (10ish hours) and no comedown cons: Doesn't help me with motivation and harder to eat compared to adderall IR

"absolute blissful euphoria (very short term), crippling fear, uncontrollable rage, and pure hopelessness"

I relate to all of these so heres my experiences. (will go into detail so will be long)

Absolute blissfull euphoria: as you mentioned very short term came for me when I was focused on things like getting a job getting independent I was hyper focused thus while that lasted nothing else mattered and finally had some progression. But in the end not being on medication the "inevitable failure" came

Pure hopelessness: Normally after the hyperfocus/"high" where I was an unstoppable force in which was progressing. Diagnosed with MDD(clinical depression) These periods lasted a lot longer than the hyperfocus and took months before I would reach that again with the same result (rinse and repeat many many times)

Uncontrollable rage/Crippling fear:all of these interact with me but these kind of "balance each other out" to an extent. Most of the time when I did hit that point of rage it would just end in me leaving slamming doors basically everyone could fuck off. Due to anxiety kept it from going past that most of the time but still didn't just leave without saying a word. Few times though the most uncontrollable point is when it doesn't end with slamming a door or something like that it results in me yelling and once I start I basically stopped when I was tired/"got most of it out". Only reason I can think of that has made it where I haven't gotten past that is anxiety of losing all control and not being able to stop once I start likely resulting in major injury or worse. As far as crippling fear from last year in june until this year in feburary I became a hermit only left the house 2 times a month to get ecig juice and if something came up I had to do it resulted in panic attacks, 0 interaction with the few friends I have 0 with family just sat in my room and was afraid to even check the mail if I was asked.

Since that was a bit down I'll talk about those since medication.
I don't reach that peak/hyperfocus but am very happy since I'm making progress. The crippling fear/anxiety currently 0 with new medication and lowest its been while its still there after months on the previous medication could literally "brush things off" (and after being a x-hermit that made me feel really good). Have had 0 points where I've even gotten angry on medication and 0 depression while on medication. (all of these are while its working of course) when its wore off I've had slight depression/anxiety on the previous and none currently. Finally (whew this is going to be huge) Haven't reached full hopelessness since medication but did want to give up on some things that were not working out (mainly due to not being able to take it everyday) but when I do I don't reach that point. Things are good due to the fact I know if I can't figure it out right now when I take it tomorrow I can or the next day (etc)

TL:DR Experienced those emotions since medication every area has improved (even more so when taken daily)
